name: Rancho Cucamonga Library and Animal Center Teen Volunteers
what_you_do: Help at library events and summer reading. Plan teen events with the Teen Advisory Group. Or help care for shelter pets as a Pet Cadet, with a parent.
who_can_apply: Library Special Events and Summer Reading helpers are 12 and up. Second Story and Beyond helpers are 16 and up. The Teen Advisory Group is for grades 7 to 12. Pet Cadets are 12 to 17, and a parent must come to every training and shift.
duration: Summer Reading helpers give 2 hours a week for 8 weeks. The Teen Advisory Group meets the first Wednesday of each month at 6 pm.
deadline_text: No deadline is posted. You can apply any time.
how_to_apply: For the library, fill out the city volunteer form and pick Library Services. For Pet Cadets, you and a parent each fill out the Animal Center form.
notes: Teen Advisory Group meets at the Biane Library or on Zoom. You get volunteer hours there only after the form is in. A Pet Cadet form without a parent form is turned down. Fire Explorers are 16 to 21, and the city does not take court ordered hours.
